[[G.O.L.E.M. 1.0]]s are summoned by dropping an [[Asuran Beacon]]. During [[Genius Operated Living Enchanted Manifestation]] your party can summon up to 2 golems, in [[Riven Earth]] you can only summon one.

== Locations ==
* [[Tarnished Coast]]
** {{NPC location|Riven Earth}} (after [[Genius Operated Living Enchanted Manifestation]])

* {{monster skill icon|Energy Blast (golem)}}
* {{monster skill icon|Golem Boosters}}
* {{monster skill icon|Vitality Transfer}}

== Dialogue ==
When "talking" to the Golem, you will alternately get one of two responses.
: ''"I'll wait here until you're ready."''
: ''"<Character Name>, I'll follow you."''

== Notes ==
*The golem is considerably slower than players and will stop moving if its leader goes out of compass range.
